preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in palindrome)
preconditions.description: Every character in `palindrome` is a lowercase English letter.
The input string `palindrome` is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards).
The length of `palindrome` is between 1 and 1000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: (return_value == '' and len(palindrome) == 1) or (return_value != '' and len(return_value) == len(palindrome))
postconditions.description: If the input is a single character (`len(palindrome) == 1`), return the empty string. Otherwise, return a string of the same length as `palindrome`.
If a non-empty string is returned, it must not be a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: return_value != '' implies all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: If a non-empty string is returned, it consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value != '' implies (return_value < palindrome) and any(return_value[i] != palindrome[i] for i in range(len(palindrome)))
postconditions.description: If a non-empty string is returned, it is lexicographically smaller than `palindrome` and differs in exactly one character position.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' or (return_value != '' and not any(return_value[i] != palindrome[i] for i in range(len(palindrome))))
postconditions.description: If a non-empty string is returned, it differs from `palindrome` in exactly one character. If no such string exists, return the empty string.
